Metal has material-specific edge softness and thin local bevel light, not an equally sharp continuous contour. Retain rounded nuanced volume, fine paper/page stack and terminal structure at the working surface, softly bounced coloured light and contact shadows. No flat polygonal cel faces, no global blur, no blanket zero-texture rule and no hyperreal photographic finish. Match the primary source's actual balanced selective detail. Window key neutral warm-white, grey-green fill shadows keep richer colours; E3's slightly excessive warm/ochre cast should be tempered toward the original.
